mechanism: Tramadol is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; progesterone may inhibit CYP3A4, increasing tramadol levels and serotonergic effects, while both agents have CNS depressant properties.
action: Monitor for increased tramadol side effects (dizziness, sedation, serotonin syndrome); consider dose reduction if CNS symptoms emerge; counsel on fall risk and avoid concurrent CNS depressants.
